comment: DGX port — detection stack uses non-adversary / American models only. DO NOT edit test.jsonl or dev.jsonl.

training_data._class_balance_info: Current distribution in train.jsonl (informational only — not used by code)

dgx.notes: Compile and infer on Nemotron (NVIDIA, US). Optional cloud: Sonnet compile / Opus infer. Never put Qwen/DeepSeek in the detection brain.

_metric_weights_note: Metric weights are hardcoded in tslit_dspy/metrics.py (0.50 category, 0.20 risk, 0.20 evidence, 0.10 QA).
notes: DGX defaults: local vLLM Nemotron for compile+infer (policy-safe). For cloud R&D parity set compile_model=anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6 and inference_model=anthropic/claude-opus-4-6 with ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
